title: Thrist Datapack
description: This datapack adds a realistic thirst bar to Minecraft.
body:
# Realistic Thirst

Bring a new survival challenge to Minecraft with a fully functional **thirst system**.

This datapack, combined with the included **required resource pack**, adds a **realistic thirst bar** to the game. The resource pack is necessary to display the thirst bar correctly in the HUD. Just like hunger, your thirst gradually decreases over time, forcing you to **drink water regularly** to stay hydrated.

## Features

* 💧 A brand-new thirst bar integrated into the HUD.
* 🌍 Realistic hydration mechanic that fits naturally into survival gameplay.
* 🥤 Drink water to restore your thirst.
* ⚠️ Ignore your thirst for too long, and you'll suffer negative effects.
* 🎮 Multiplayer compatible.
* 📦 Lightweight and easy to install.
* 🎨 **Requires the included resource pack** to display the thirst bar properly.
